name: Goldlok Holdings(Guangdong) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Goldlok Holdings (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., headquartered in Puning, China, is a company dedicated to the creation, production, and marketing of electronic and plastic-based toys. Their extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of items such as electric trains, interactive robots designed for sparring, battery-operated vehicles, wire-controlled model aircraft, intelligent dolls, and eco-friendly magnets. The company also produces educational writing boards, soft plush toys, various learning-oriented toys, smart interactive toys, merchandise based on licensed intellectual property, and general gift products. These items are made available to consumers within China through a variety of retail channels, including department stores, major supermarkets, chain stores, and specialized gift shops. Beyond its domestic operations, Goldlok Holdings extends its reach internationally, distributing its products across the United States, Latin America, the European Union, and several regions throughout Asia, including Hong Kong. In addition to its core toy business, the company also engages in general trading activities. Goldlok Holdings functions as a subsidiary entity of Xingchang Plastics Hardware Factory Co., Ltd.
